About this item

  • COMPACT 5-CUP CAPACITY: Brew the right amount of fresh, hot coffee for personal use, couples, or small households without wasting a full pot.
  • PAUSE AND SERVE: Pour a quick cup during the brewing cycle when you are short on time, then return the carafe to continue brewing.
  • REUSABLE FILTER: Includes a removable reusable filter housed in a convenient swing-out basket for easy filling and cleaning.
  • SIMPLE, CONVENIENT OPERATION: The semi-transparent water reservoir includes an easy-to-read level indicator, while the illuminated on/off switch provides effortless brewing without complicated settings.
  • TRUSTED BRAND: As a trusted brand for over 40 years, Elite Gourmet has delivered high quality and stylish kitchen products that are affordable & user friendly. Contact our U.S.-based support team by phone, email, or live chat if you have questions about your product.

Product Description

Start your day off right with the Elite Gourmet 5-Cup Coffeemaker. With its compact and sleek design that takes up limited counter space and fits into any nook. It is perfect for small spaces such as office kitchens, dorm rooms or recreatiol vehicles. Quickly and effortlessly brew your favorite coffee to jump start your day. No need to stop at a local coffee house to buy a cup of joe just to make it through the day. You can also use your own coffee grounds in the included reusable filter. Simply add fresh water for each brew. Cleanup is a cinch, all removable parts and accessories are dishwasher safe. Enjoy a cup of joe on the go with the Elite Gourmet 4-Cup Coffeemaker

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
great LITTLE coffee maker
I knew this was tiny when I ordered it. I am not a fan of pods. I have done French press for single-serve. But I wanted a drip maker I could use a paper filter with (this takes #2 cone filters...or the included "permanent" filter, which is not the same as a paper filter, but I digress). But this is perfect for me ... their "four cups" makes just slightly more than a mug of coffee. See the photo. And that's not a huge mug. If you like drip coffee, but don't want to brew enough for the Waffle House, this is for you. Good value. UPDATE: Now that I've had this awhile, not taking away any stars, but there are a couple things to note. As some other reviewer(s) have mentioned, you can't use the power switch without holding the unit down with your other hand. It requires too much pressure, and the unit is too light. The decanter is miniature in every way, including the pouring lip. So if you think you have to pour slowly from your full-size decanter that doesn't have a wide lip, you really have to slow down with this. When will product designers learn? EVERYONE likes a wide lip on the decanter, not just servers. NOBODY likes the little narrow ones. We're pouring into mugs, not espresso cups. And finally, the "sneak a cup" feature on this doesn't really work ... it continues to drip. I think maybe the spring is too weak, but it also could be the gasket isn't pliable/wide enough. But if you can't wait for this tiny little batch to brew, you are really jonesing. Anyway, still five stars, because, look at the price.

    I really like this coffee maker. I've been using it every day for about three months, and it has worked perfectly without any issues.

    One of my favorite features is the reusable filter. It helps reduce waste, and I like not having to buy or throw away paper filters. The size is also perfect for one or two people. It makes just the right amount of coffee for my morning routine, and I can easily take some with me to work.

    This is a simple coffee maker, but that's exactly what I was looking for. I enjoy starting my day with a hot cup of coffee, and bringing coffee from home has helped me save a lot of money by not buying coffee every day. Personally, I like to drink my coffee black, so I'd rather spend my money on high-quality coffee beans than on expensive coffee drinks.

    Overall, I highly recommend this coffee maker. It's affordable, reliable, easy to use, and perfect for anyone who wants a simple machine that makes great coffee every day.

    Morning Perfection: Elite Gourmet EHC4128 Automatic 4-Cup Brew & Drip Coffee Maker Review
    Reviewed in the United States on August 11, 2024

    Elevate your morning routine with the Elite Gourmet EHC4128 Automatic 4-Cup Brew & Drip Coffee Maker. Designed for coffee lovers who crave convenience and quality, this compact yet powerful machine offers an exceptional brewing experience that delivers the perfect cup of coffee every time. Whether you're a busy professional or a coffee enthusiast seeking the ultimate morning brew, this coffee maker is your ticket to coffee perfection. Here’s why the Elite Gourmet EHC4128 is the ideal addition to your kitchen:

    Compact and Efficient Design

    The Elite Gourmet EHC4128 features a sleek and compact design that fits seamlessly into any kitchen or office space. Its small footprint makes it perfect for those with limited counter space, while its elegant appearance complements any decor. Despite its size, this coffee maker boasts the power and functionality needed to brew a rich, flavorful cup of coffee with ease.

    Perfectly Brewed Coffee

    This 4-cup coffee maker is equipped with advanced brewing technology that ensures consistent and optimal extraction of coffee flavors. The result is a rich, aromatic brew that rivals your favorite coffee shop. The brewing process is quick and efficient, allowing you to enjoy a piping hot cup of coffee in just minutes, perfect for busy mornings or a quick pick-me-up during the day.

    Pause N Serve Feature

    One of the standout features of the Elite Gourmet EHC4128 is the Pause N Serve function, which allows you to pour a cup of coffee mid-brew without making a mess. This convenient feature lets you enjoy a fresh cup of coffee as soon as you need it, without waiting for the entire pot to finish brewing. Simply pause the brewing process, pour your cup, and resume brewing with ease.

    Easy-to-Use and Maintain

    The coffee maker’s intuitive design makes it incredibly easy to use, even for those new to coffee brewing. The simple control panel allows you to start brewing with the push of a button, while the clear water level indicator ensures precise measurements every time. Cleaning is also a breeze, thanks to the removable filter basket and drip tray, which can be easily washed and reassembled for hassle-free maintenance.

    Energy Efficient and Safe

    The Elite Gourmet EHC4128 is designed with energy efficiency in mind, featuring an automatic shut-off function that turns off the coffee maker after brewing is complete. This not only saves energy but also provides peace of mind, knowing that your coffee maker is safe and secure when not in use.

    Ideal for Small Households

    With its 4-cup capacity, this coffee maker is perfect for small households or individuals who want just the right amount of coffee without waste. It’s ideal for those who appreciate a fresh brew each time without the need to store excess coffee.

    Verdict

    The Elite Gourmet EHC4128 Automatic 4-Cup Brew & Drip Coffee Maker is a perfect blend of convenience, quality, and style. With its compact design, efficient brewing capabilities, and user-friendly features, this coffee maker is an excellent choice for anyone looking to enjoy a perfect cup of coffee at home. Whether you're rushing out the door or enjoying a leisurely morning, the Elite Gourmet EHC4128 ensures that your coffee is brewed to perfection, every time. Start your day off right with this reliable and stylish coffee maker!

About this Item

  • COMPACT 5-CUP CAPACITY: Brew the right amount of fresh, hot coffee for personal use, couples, or small households without wasting a full pot.
  • PAUSE AND SERVE: Pour a quick cup during the brewing cycle when you are short on time, then return the carafe to continue brewing.
  • REUSABLE FILTER: Includes a removable reusable filter housed in a convenient swing-out basket for easy filling and cleaning.
  • SIMPLE, CONVENIENT OPERATION: The semi-transparent water reservoir includes an easy-to-read level indicator, while the illuminated on/off switch provides effortless brewing without complicated settings.
  • TRUSTED BRAND: As a trusted brand for over 40 years, Elite Gourmet has delivered high quality and stylish kitchen products that are affordable & user friendly. Contact our U.S.-based support team by phone, email, or live chat if you have questions about your product.

Product Description

Start your day off right with the Elite Gourmet 5-Cup Coffeemaker. With its compact and sleek design that takes up limited counter space and fits into any nook. It is perfect for small spaces such as office kitchens, dorm rooms or recreatiol vehicles. Quickly and effortlessly brew your favorite coffee to jump start your day. No need to stop at a local coffee house to buy a cup of joe just to make it through the day. You can also use your own coffee grounds in the included reusable filter. Simply add fresh water for each brew. Cleanup is a cinch, all removable parts and accessories are dishwasher safe. Enjoy a cup of joe on the go with the Elite Gourmet 4-Cup Coffeemaker
